summary: Tested Channel Visibility settings feature on POS frontend app. Found and fixed critical bug where channel visibility settings were not being saved to localStorage. Also fixed issue where dashboard wasn't reading updated settings when navigating back from config page.

bugs_fixed.issue: Channel visibility config was not being saved to localStorage in saveConfiguration function
Channel visibility config was not being loaded from localStorage on component mount
bugs_fixed.fix: Added useEffect to load channel config from localStorage on mount

bugs_fixed.issue: Dashboard wasn't reading updated channel visibility settings when navigating back from config page (React Router keeps component mounted)
bugs_fixed.fix: Added useLocation hook and useEffect with location.pathname dependency to re-read localStorage when route changes

status_config_page.channel_visibility_section_visible: PASS - 4 toggle cards (Dine-In, TakeAway, Delivery, Room) displayed
status_config_page.override_toggle_works: PASS - Toggle switches between Override ON/OFF
status_config_page.channel_cards_toggle: PASS - Individual channel cards can be toggled on/off

dashboard.default_status_pills: PASS - Shows YTC, Preparing, Ready, Served (4 out of 9)
dashboard.all_4_columns_visible_initially: PASS - Dine-In, TakeAway, Delivery, Room all visible
dashboard.channel_hidden_after_toggle_off: PASS - TakeAway column hidden when toggled off and saved
dashboard.all_columns_visible_when_override_off: PASS - All 4 columns visible when Override is OFF

context_for_next_testing_agent: Channel Visibility feature is fully working. The settings are saved to localStorage key 'mygenie_channel_visibility'. Dashboard reads this on mount and when navigating back from config page. Login takes ~25 seconds due to data loading. Status Config page is at /visibility/status-config (Sidebar > Visibility Settings > Status Configuration). Channel Visibility section is at the bottom of the page - need to scroll down to see it.
